description: Three canonical probes (H1: λ_alt sign flip; H2: [2]_q std weight; H3: chirality as Term-5 multiplicative factor) investigating PR #450's −56% neutron-mass residual. No fitting; each variant has a content-block-cited rationale or is explicitly flagged as exploratory. Read-only investigation: does NOT modify alpha_blend_tower.py or any existing test.

results.name: h1_alt_sign_flip
results.description: V = W_SYM·λ_sym − W_ALT·λ_alt + W_STD·V_std (negate the chirality contribution)
results.justification_check: λ_alt(σ_i) = -q⁻¹ from sign-rep convention. Flipping the sign in V is equivalent to using λ_alt(σ_i) = +q⁻¹, which would correspond to a different choice of antipode convention. Not standard — flagged as exploratory.

results.name: h2_std_weight_q2_q
results.description: W_STD = (q²+1) · [2]_q / D where [2]_q = q + q⁻¹; sym/alt re-scaled so weights sum to 1.
results.justification_check: Plancherel weights are dim_q(λ)²/[n]_q!; replacing dim_q([2,1])² with dim_q([2,1])·[2]_q breaks the standard Wedderburn convention. Probe is exploratory — would only be canonical if [wedderburn-trace-identity.md] is reread with a different normalization.

results.name: h3_chirality_as_factor
results.description: V_per_vertex without alt channel; chirality factor a_K = λ_alt(g0)·λ_alt(g1) applied multiplicatively to the tower output (per Term 5 of six-term-mass-formula).
results.justification_check: Per six-term-mass-formula-complete.md, Term 5 (a_K · 𝒞_K) is a multiplicative chirality factor applied to the tower mass, not summed inside the per-vertex V. This probe factors the structure that way, using the per-crossing λ_alt product as a proxy for a_K. If neutron lands close to CODATA, this is the canonical structural decomposition; otherwise the chirality content needs a different construction (cf. ribbon_content_average.content_average).

data.recommendation: None of H1/H2/H3 closes the gap below 1e+07 ppb. Smallest residual: h2_std_weight_q2_q at -2.55e+08 ppb. Next probe should investigate combinations or higher-order corrections (e.g. Term 4 Frobenius co-Casimir, brane-tower per-vertex spectral-sequence higher pages).
